title: feat(nsopzft): nsopp z-probe formation-tick exist-opposite: reverse fails, face fails
science: Formation-tick exist-opposite on nsopp z-probes where all four S are singletons ({+e1},{+e3},{+e3},{+e3}) and both bits fail. Useful as the extreme of the narrow end of the window chain: singleton sets cannot hold, so the fail is forced by set size, not by geometry.
